item.title: TravelTech meetup talk
item.dc:creator: Mike Spencer
item.description:
I spoke at Edinburgh’s TravelTech meetup last night. It’s a friendly event organised by Joshua Ryan-Saha and Maddy Burgoyne.

My talk was on using OpenStreetMap data, despite the session topic no AI was involved. I think it was appropriate as I included tips on accessing OSM data in a sustainable way and structured data is very much AI ready.

You can view my slides on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.24531364

I spoke about some of the ways I’ve used OSM data in the past, along with a challenge to the community about Le Tour De France preparedness! Joshua asked a great question on what am I currently working on. I took a sabbatical in the summer and cycled to Denmark with my family. It was a great opporunity to compare communities between home and the three countries we cycled through. Unsurpringly, I had lots of thoughts about accommodation and resilience!
